Info

Factory service constructing StreamExecutionWorker background workers.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.worker.stream_execution_worker_factory.StreamExecutionWorkerFactory[source]¶

Bases: object

Factory providing creation of StreamExecutionWorker instances.

It defines:

methods:
create - Constructs StreamExecutionWorker with internal default formatter.
create_with_formatter - Constructs StreamExecutionWorker with explicit formatter.
get_version - Returns factory version string.
classmethod create(*, pacing_bundle: FlowPacingBundle, command_sender: ICommandSender, state_controller: IStreamStateController, observer_dispatcher: IStreamObserverDispatcher, pacing_config: StreamPacingConfig) → StreamExecutionWorker[source]¶

Constructs and returns a configured StreamExecutionWorker instance.

Parameters:

  • pacing_bundle – FlowPacingBundle managing pacing and barrier.

  • command_sender – ICommandSender transmitting raw command packets.

  • state_controller – IStreamStateController managing stream lifecycle state.

  • observer_dispatcher – IStreamObserverDispatcher emitting progress and logs.

  • pacing_config – StreamPacingConfig with loop pacing delays.

Returns:

StreamExecutionWorker instance.

Exceptions:

None.

classmethod create_with_formatter(*, pacing_bundle: FlowPacingBundle, formatter: ICommandFormatter, command_sender: ICommandSender, state_controller: IStreamStateController, observer_dispatcher: IStreamObserverDispatcher, pacing_config: StreamPacingConfig) → StreamExecutionWorker[source]¶

Constructs and returns a configured StreamExecutionWorker with explicit formatter.

Parameters:

  • pacing_bundle – FlowPacingBundle managing pacing and barrier.

  • formatter – ICommandFormatter instance encoding waypoints.

  • command_sender – ICommandSender transmitting raw command packets.

  • state_controller – IStreamStateController managing stream lifecycle state.

  • observer_dispatcher – IStreamObserverDispatcher emitting progress and logs.

  • pacing_config – StreamPacingConfig with loop pacing delays.

Returns:

StreamExecutionWorker instance.

Exceptions:

None.
